I could not answer the question. The Falkon tools available to me cannot list commits, PRs, or diffs, so I can't tell which merged PRs since 2026-04-16 added or removed a `lineItems` line, or when each merged.

What I could establish:

- The repository is named `github.com/openmrs/openmrs-esm-billing-app` in Falkon. The bare name `openmrs-esm-billing-app` returned "not found", so the full name is needed for calls.
- A grep of `src` at the default branch finds 192 matching lines across 47 files. That is the current state only, not change history.
- `list_commits` is not available in this session, and the Falkon server instructions mention `list_commits` and `get_diff`. Without them, nothing here shows which commits touched `lineItems`.
- No pinned head was given, and my checkout is only `openmrs-esm-patient-chart`, so I could not check the main-line boundary either.

Lines at the default branch that reference `lineItems` in `src`, for orientation only. They show where the term lives, not which PRs changed it:

- `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billing-form/billing-form.workspace.tsx:201-236`: builds `lineItems` for bill create/update payloads.
- `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/bill-item-actions/edit-bill-item.modal.tsx:97-109`: edits `lineItems` on a bill.
- `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/billing.resource.ts:43-74`: filters voided line items and defines the `lineItems` field selection.
- `openmrs-esm-billing-app/src/types/index.ts:41`: `lineItems` in the bill type.

To answer the question, I need either a Falkon tool that exposes commit or PR history (`list_commits` / `get_diff` or equivalent), or a local clone of `openmrs-esm-billing-app` where I can run `git log -p` over `src` from 2026-04-16 to the pinned head.
